text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Cases of overdosage of tranexamic acid have been reported. Based on these reports, symptoms of overdosage may be gastrointestinal, e.g, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea; hypotensive, e.g, orthostatic symptoms; thromboembolic; e.g, arterial, venous, embolic; visual impairment; mental status changes; myoclonus and rash. Tranexamic acid is not dialyzable.

10 OVERDOSAGE Cases of overdosage of tranexamic acid have been reported. Based on these reports, symptoms of overdosage may be gastrointestinal, e.g., nausea, vomiting, diarrhea; hypotensive, e.g., orthostatic symptoms; thromboembolic; e.g., arterial, venous, embolic; neurologic, e.g., visual impairment, convulsions, headache, mental status changes; myoclonus; and rash. Tranexamic acid is not dialyzable.
